rubrics.justification: The response correctly recognizes the very poor Gardner grade (1DD) but introduces a grading inconsistency and states expansion as <50% despite the provided lab note saying at least half the embryo; it is also incomplete and lacks image-grounded detail on ICM, TE, zona, and overall appearance.
The visible response does not meaningfully integrate patient age, BMI, ovarian reserve, male factor, prior cycle history, or endometrium with embryo quality.
It identifies a discrepancy in the grading description, which is reasonable, but the response is truncated and does not develop a complete, internally supported reasoning chain.
What is shown is broadly consistent with Gardner grading concepts, but the incomplete response prevents confirmation of evidence-based recommendations or full guideline adherence.
No concrete transfer recommendations, prognosis framing, or future cycle planning are provided in the visible response.
